summary.design: Expanding chronological coefficient fit; next 120 whole games for production-weight development; next 120 whole games for residual calibration; latest 40 fully graded locked games for actual-main-line validation. All fitting-source receipts precede the earliest validation quote observation. Development selects a predeclared season-aware shrinkage weight by MAE only. Count probabilities integrate Gamma-Poisson rate uncertainty. No outcome-based parameter changes occur while serving a forecast.

diagnostics.note: Correlated selections are descriptive diagnostics; only the scheduled whole-game gate may change the model.

limitation: This first actual-line check is retrospective. Its rejected holdout was not used to change candidate parameters; later builds follow the same predeclared algorithm and shifted windows. Promotion is not guaranteed.
